runs.title: CI Runs
runs.subtitle: Agent reviews executed inside CI · not local runs
runs.loadError: Could not load the CI runs.

exportWizard.title: Export to CI
exportWizard.subtitle: Run {agentName} automatically on pull requests
exportWizard.scopedSkillsNote: An attached skill is limited to certain files with Applies to. CI ignores that: every attached skill applies to every file there.
exportWizard.repoHint: owner/name — the repo to add the workflow to
exportWizard.blockMergeDesc: To block merges, set Fail CI on in the agent's CI tab so the run exits non-zero, then add it as a required status check in GitHub branch protection or rulesets. No GitHub App is needed. Also protect .github/ and .devdigest/ with CODEOWNERS and a ruleset: for pull_request events GitHub runs the workflow file from the PR itself.
exportWizard.installCardTitle: Open a PR with these files
exportWizard.installCardBody: DevDigest opens a PR in {repo} titled “Add DevDigest CI review” with the {count} generated files.
exportWizard.secretNote: Add {key} to the repo's Actions secrets before the workflow runs.
exportWizard.noGithubRepo: Connect a GitHub repository first. GitHub Actions needs a connected GitHub repository to add the workflow to.
exportWizard.existingNote: This agent is already installed in this repository. Continuing updates the existing configuration.
exportWizard.providerBlocked: This agent uses the {provider} provider. The CI runner supports OpenRouter only, so it cannot be exported yet. Switch the provider to OpenRouter in Config.
exportWizard.workflowEditNote: Triggers and "Post results as" are set in Configure. Any further change to the workflow belongs in the export PR on GitHub, where you review it. The server refuses any other difference.
exportWizard.updateNote: Update CI config: edits made by hand to these files in the repository are not carried over.
exportWizard.triggerMin: Keep at least one trigger on.
exportWizard.secretOpenrouterDesc: Your OpenRouter key — the same key you set in Settings
exportWizard.installZipBody: DevDigest builds a zip with the {count} generated files. Unpack it in the repository root and commit it.
exportWizard.zipDownloaded: The zip was downloaded as devdigest-ci.zip.

errors.provider_not_openrouter: This agent does not use OpenRouter, so it cannot run in CI. Switch the provider in Config.
errors.manifest_invalid: The agent's configuration is not valid for export.
errors.workflow_invalid: The workflow breaks a safety rule. Go back to Preview and fix it.
errors.token_missing: No GitHub token is configured for this repository. Add one in Settings.
errors.missing_workflow_permission: The GitHub token can't write workflow files. Classic token: enable the workflow scope. Fine-grained token: set Workflows → Read and write (plus Contents and Pull requests → Read and write, Actions → Read). Edit it at github.com/settings/tokens, or paste a new one in Settings → API keys, then click Install again.
errors.branch_protected: The devdigest/ci branch is protected and cannot be replaced. Add the files by hand from a zip.
errors.foreign_commits: The devdigest/ci branch has commits that DevDigest did not make, so it was left untouched. Add the files by hand from a zip.
errors.foreign_commits_detail: The devdigest/ci branch already has a commit DevDigest did not make: {sha}{hasAuthor, select, yes { by {author}} other {}}{hasDate, select, yes { on {date}} other {}}{hasSubject, select, yes { — "{subject}"} other {}}. It is {ahead, plural, one {# commit} other {# commits}} ahead of the base branch. If it is stale, delete the branch on GitHub and click Install again; otherwise add the files by hand from a zip.
errors.foreign_commits_truncated: The devdigest/ci branch is more than 100 commits ahead of the base branch and has a commit DevDigest did not make. If it is stale, delete the branch on GitHub and click Install again; otherwise add the files by hand from a zip.
errors.branch_moved: The devdigest/ci branch changed while installing. Try again, or add the files by hand from a zip.
errors.repo_has_other_agent: This repository already runs a different DevDigest agent.

ciTab.heading: CI deployment
ciTab.activeBadge: Active in {count, plural, one {# repo} other {# repos}}
ciTab.loadError: Could not load the CI installations.
ciTab.emptyBody: Add this agent to CI to open a PR that adds the workflow and the agent config to a repository.
ciTab.inactiveHint: This repository is no longer connected in DevDigest, so its runs are not fetched.
ciTab.pendingHint: The export PR is not merged yet, so the agent does not run in this repo.
ciTab.outOfDateHint: The repo has an older agent or workflow version. Run Update CI config.
ciTab.gateDrift: This repo still uses the old gate ({exported}). The agent now blocks on {current}. Run Update CI config to apply it.

failOn.label: Fail CI on
failOn.hint: Edits the agent's CI gate. Saving creates a new agent version; repos keep the old gate until you run Update CI config.

remove.title: Remove {repo} from CI?
remove.body: This deletes only the DevDigest installation record. Past CI runs are kept. The files DevDigest added to the repository (the workflow and .devdigest/) stay there and must be removed by hand.

update.title: Update CI config
update.body: Which installation do you want to update?

publishDialog.title: Publish to CI
publishDialog.subtitle: Run {agentName} on every pull request in {repo}
publishDialog.intro: Opens a pull request in {repo} adding a GitHub Actions workflow + this agent's config under .devdigest/. On every PR the agent reviews the diff.
publishDialog.secretNote: Add {key} to the repo's Actions secrets before the workflow runs. GITHUB_TOKEN is provided automatically.
publishDialog.doneBody: Opened/updated a pull request in {repo} with the workflow + agent config.
